StatusLIVE REVIEW DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder-level pricing control board for concession requests, margin guardrails, quote validity, proforma release, exception recovery, and forecast-quality protection across live commercial matters.
Source ruleUpdate deal rooms, pricing-review records, formal offer packets, proformas, profitability reviews, revenue forecast, exception governance, capital allocation, credit release controls, and linked customer response records first, then refresh this board.
Decision ruleNo strategic quote, concession, or proforma should leave controlled review unless margin protection, expiry logic, response requirements, release posture, and recovery path all tell the same story.
